<?php
class Token53 {
    public function __destruct() { echo "D53\n"; }
}
function Park53($token) {
    echo "B53\n";
    $received = Fiber::suspend("pause53");
    echo "R53\n";
    echo "RECEIVED|", (int) ($received === "sent53"), "|\n";
    yield "cache53";
    echo "E53\n";
    return "return53";
}
$token = new Token53();
$weak = WeakReference::create($token);
$g = Park53($token);
unset($token);
$f = new Fiber(function () use ($g) {
    echo "F53\n";
    echo "CURRENT|", (int) ($g->current() === "cache53"), "|\n";
    echo "C53\n";
    return "fiber53";
});
echo "START|", (int) ($f->start() === "pause53"), "|\n";
echo "PARKED|", (int) $f->isSuspended(), "|", (int) ($weak->get() !== null), "|\n";
try {
    $g->next();
} catch (Throwable $error) {
    echo "REENTRY53\n";
    echo get_class($error), "|", $error->getMessage(), "\n";
    echo "PREVIOUS-NULL|", (int) ($error->getPrevious() === null), "|\n";
}
echo "RESUME|", (int) ($f->resume("sent53") === null), "|\n";
echo "FIBER|", (int) $f->isTerminated(), "|", (int) ($f->getReturn() === "fiber53"), "|\n";
echo "CACHE|", (int) ($g->current() === "cache53"), "|", (int) ($weak->get() !== null), "|\n";
$g->next();
echo "RETURN|", (int) ($g->getReturn() === "return53"), "|", (int) ($weak->get() === null), "|\n";
unset($g, $f, $weak);
echo "END53\n";

<?php
